notablePrerequisites: You are able to draw a card.
description:
Activate Words of War by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Attempt to draw a card, with the draw being replaced by Words of War dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of War by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet ability, replacing the first card draw with Words of War dealing 2 damage to an opponent, and causing you to draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat from step 4.
